I implemented `parse`, `parse_script` and `parse_expression` in `minidb/parser.py`, and all 33 tests in `tests/test_parser.py` pass. I did not run the integration tests, and I made no changes to the test file.

The parser is a private `_P` class holding a token cursor and one method per grammar rule. The three public functions wrap it.

I wrote it to the grammar in `minidb/types.py`, so I haven't checked it against the held-back tests beyond that.
